---
title: 'Not reported — Alternative aggregation rules, tests of ND'
format: html
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, arrow, here, polars, DIDmultiplegtDYN, fect)

data_majority <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly_majority.parquet"))
data_all_months <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly_all_months.parquet"))
```

## Majority rule (2 of 3 months)

### Test of time-constant effects

#### k = 2

```{r}
majority_t2 <- did_multiplegt_dyn(
  df             = data_majority,
  outcome        = "n_installations_per_1000",
  group          = "id",
  time           = "time",
  treatment      = "treatment",
  effects        = 2,
  placebo        = 2,
  same_switchers = TRUE,
  effects_equal  = TRUE
)
print(majority_t2)
```

### Carry-over test

#### s = 2

```{r}
majority_carry_2 <- fect(
  n_installations_per_1000 ~ treatment,
  data             = data_majority,
  index            = c("MunicipalityCode", "time"),
  method           = "fe",
  force            = "two-way",
  se               = TRUE,
  nboots           = 1000,
  parallel         = TRUE,
  seed             = 42,
  carryoverTest    = TRUE,
  carryover.period = c(1, 2)
)
majority_carry_2$test.out
majority_carry_2$est.carryover
majority_carry_2$est.att.off
```
